[[File:TCGMix homepage - 7 November 2026.png|thumb|TCGMix homepage.]]
'''TCGMix''' is a fan-run website for playing card games in a web browser. Its playtests include a prototype for [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars CCG]].<ref name="home" />

== Star Wars CCG prototype ==

[[File:TCGMix Star Wars CCG prototype - 7 November 2026.png|thumb|Star Wars CCG prototype.]]
Players can create a room to play against another player or start a game against a bot. Visitors can browse cards and public decks without an account. Playing and saving decks require signing in.<ref name="starwars" />

== Other games ==

The featured games include ''[[Young Jedi CCG]]'', ''Stargate TCG'', ''Harry Potter TCG'' and ''Star Trek CCG First Edition''. Other playtests include ''Star Trek CCG Second Edition'', ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game|Jedi Knights TCG]]'', ''WARS Trading Card Game'' and ''The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game''.<ref name="home" /><ref name="playtests" />

TCGMix is free to play. Players earn cards, progress rewards and shop credits through play.<ref name="home" />

== History and community ==

By 2 October 2026, TCGMix featured ''Young Jedi'', ''Stargate'' and ''Harry Potter''. The latter two games used separate accounts for Kawoosh Online and Diagon Duels, respectively.<ref name="october" /> TCGMix has a Discord community for its games.<ref name="home" />
